datasets.name: ODSFranshiz
datasets.sql:
select itf.ammount as franshiz, it.ammount as tariff
  from ins_tarif_franshiz itf, ins_tariffs it
where month_id = :month_id
order by itf.ammount

datasets.name: AValute
datasets.sql: select valute, val_name, valu_name, valu_short from avalute

datasets.name: Policy
datasets.sql:
select  imp.rowid, imp.* from ins_mf_policy imp
where imp.ms_id= :ms_id

datasets.name: Suggest_Rep
datasets.sql:
select s.rowid,s.* from ins_mf_suggestion s
where mk_id = :mk_id

datasets.name: Ins_MotorFull
datasets.sql: select im.rowid,im.* from ins_motorfull im where im.id=:id

datasets.name: Suggestion
datasets.sql:
select s.rowid,s.* from ins_mf_suggestion s
where mk_id = :mk_id

datasets.name: Risks
datasets.sql: select idr.rowid, idr.* from ins_dict_risks idr

datasets.name: Customers
datasets.sql: select c.rowid,c.id,c.name||' '||c.surname||' '||c.fathername as name,c.address,c.mobilephone,c.fax from ins_customers c

datasets.name: Conditions
datasets.sql: select idr.rowid, idr.* from ins_dict_conditions idr

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
select ic.rowid, ic.* from ins_contracts ic
where id = :cid
and type_id = 4

datasets.name: ODSReliaseDates
datasets.sql:
select * from ins_release_date
where to_number(to_char(begindate, 'YYYY')) <= :releaseyear
and to_number(to_char(enddate, 'YYYY')) >= :releaseyear
and state_id in (select its.id from ins_tarif_states its
                  where its.state_id = :state )
